description: This file defines structures, classes, and function prototypes for controlling and interacting with WPA supplicant via a control interface. It includes a struct definition for a WPA control handle, an interface class for implementation, a wrapper class for static access, and external function pointers.

classes.name: WpaCtrlApiImpl
classes.description: An abstract class defining the interface for WPA control operations.

classes.name: WpaCtrlApi
classes.description: A wrapper class providing static methods to interact with WPA control functions.

methods.name: setImpl
methods.description: Sets the implementation instance used by WpaCtrlApi.

methods.name: wpa_ctrl_open
methods.description: Opens a control connection to the WPA supplicant.

methods.name: wpa_ctrl_request
methods.description: Sends a control request and waits for a reply.

methods.name: wpa_ctrl_pending
methods.description: Checks if there are pending messages.

methods.name: wpa_ctrl_recv
methods.description: Receives a message from WPA control interface.

methods.name: wpa_ctrl_attach
methods.description: Attaches to the WPA control interface for event notifications.
